mapper.insert: insert into sys_operation_log(actor_id, actor_username, action, target_type, target_id, success, summary, trace_id, duration_ms) values(#{c.actorId}, #{c.actorUsername}, #{c.action}, #{c.targetType}, #{c.targetId}, #{c.success}, #{c.summary}, #{c.traceId}, 0)
insert into sys_login_log(username, user_id, success, ip, trace_id) values(#{username}, #{userId}, #{success}, #{ip}, #{traceId})
mapper.select: select id::text as id, username, success, ip, trace_id, created_at::text as created_at from sys_login_log order by id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
